sources.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources.reading: A +12% amplifier that is TYPED: it applies to magic damage only. Its scope over sources is unrestricted ("from all sources"), i.e. ally-held Abyssal Mask amplifies a teammate's magic damage against the cursed target.

sources.reading: A +7% amplifier that is UNTYPED (all damage types) and, like Unmake, unrestricted over damage sources (ally-applied). This is the only other amplifier the scenario name puts in play.
The decomposed atom for Unmake is classified under the magic-damage family, independently corroborating S1's typing.
Both item caches are current for the pinned patch, so the 7% / 12% magnitudes quoted above are the live values, not stale text.

sources.reading: Used below to reconstruct the pre-amplifier mitigated base of the event.

sources.source: data/worklists/e8d-task.md line 30 (definition of the "roster" fight shape)
sources.quote: assert in a /api/calculate fight WITH AN ALLY in the roster (enemies + allies lists are supported) that the ally's ledger receives the heal/shield
sources.reading: "roster" in a scenario name means the fight carries allies (and enemies) alongside the main participant. Imperial Mandate (enchanter support item) and Abyssal Mask (tank support item) are both ally-held in such a scenario; neither is a carry item. This matters for the discriminating argument below.

step_1_isolate_the_delta.conclusion: The two golden values differ by exactly one factor of 1.12 -- numerically identical to Abyssal Mask's Unmake amplifier (S1). No other quantity in the scenario's named mechanics equals 1.12: Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is 1.07 (197.5 x 1.07 = 211.3, not 221.2), and additive composition of the two amps would be 1.19 (184.6 x 1.19 = 219.7, matching neither value). The change is therefore exactly 'the Unmake curse is / is not applied to this event', nothing else.

step_2_reconstruct_the_base.hypothesis: new = base x 1.07 (untyped Mandate amp retained), old = base x 1.07 x 1.12 (Mandate amp x Abyssal curse)
step_2_reconstruct_the_base.check_old: 184.6154 x 1.07 x 1.12 = 221.243 -> 221.2  (matches the OLD golden value)
step_2_reconstruct_the_base.conclusion: Both golden values are the two branches of one and the same mitigated base, with and without the 12% magic curse. The residual value 197.5 still carries a ~7% amplifier, i.e. amplification as a family is still being applied to this event; only the magic-TYPED amplifier was removed.

step_3_which_branch_is_correct.premise: Under S1, applying the Unmake curse to this event is correct if and only if event[8] carries magic damage. Under S2, the 7% Vulnerable amp is correct for any damage type.
step_3_which_branch_is_correct.discriminating_argument: Both candidate items are ally-held in a roster fight (S6). Their amplifiers are alike in source-scope (both 'from all sources', both applied by an ally) and differ ONLY in damage typing (S1 typed magic; S2 untyped). Therefore: (a) a change to how ALLY-sourced amplifiers reach the main participant's ledger would have moved both factors together, producing a 1.07 x 1.12 = 1.1984 delta; (b) the observed delta is exactly 1.12 with an untyped amplifier still resident in the surviving value (step 2). A discriminator that keeps the untyped amp and drops the typed one is, by construction, a DAMAGE-TYPE gate, not a source-scope change. That is precisely the rule S1 states.
step_3_which_branch_is_correct.corroboration: No text under data/ authorises an untyped 12% amplifier from Abyssal Mask. items.json 8020 has exactly one passive branch, and it says 'magic damage'; the decomposed atom agrees (S3). A ledger event that receives 12% amplification without being magic damage has no source backing it, whereas the 197.5 branch is fully sourced (mitigation identity S5 x untyped Vulnerable S2).
step_3_which_branch_is_correct.conclusion: 197.5 is the value supported by the cached sources; 221.2 requires event[8] to be magic damage, which the selective-removal signature in step 3 rules against.

independent_computation.load_bearing_premise: This oracle cannot read the scenario definition or the event ledger (scripts/, tests/ and the baseline are out of scope by runbook), so the damage TYPE of events[8] is inferred, not observed. The inference rests on: (i) the delta being exactly the magic-only 1.12 and nothing else, and (ii) an untyped ~1.07 amplifier surviving in the new value, which excludes an ally-scope regression as the cause. If events[8] could be shown to be magic damage, the old value would instead be correct -- that is the single fact that would overturn this verdict.
independent_computation.composition_note: Both values are consistent with multiplicative composition of amplifiers (1.07 x 1.12 = 1.1984). Additive composition (1 + 0.07 + 0.12 = 1.19) reproduces neither value, so amplifier-composition semantics is not the axis of this change and no 'both_wrong' branch opens on that account.

verdict_detail.reason: Abyssal Mask's Unmake is a magic-damage-only amplifier (data/items.json 8020, passive 'Unmake': 'receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources'). The golden leaf moved by exactly that 1.12 factor while an untyped ~7% Imperial Mandate 'Vulnerable' amplifier remained in the surviving value, which is the signature of gating the curse by damage type rather than of dropping an ally-sourced aura. Applying a magic-typed amplifier to a non-magic ledger event is unsupported by every cached source; the new value 197.5 = 240 x 100/(100+30) x 1.07 is fully reconstructible from the wiki cache plus the mitigation identity in docs/math-foundations.md.
